text.t:
Delicate, original and made with great care, our personalised garlands are crafted from MDF and joined by a natural cord, ready to hang and add a special touch to any space.
Available in different shapes, such as bunting, flowers, hearts, stars... each piece represents a letter of the child's name. The letters are made from plywood and covered with fabric in the colour chosen by you, allowing for a unique and harmonious combination.
Perfect for decorating nurseries, children's rooms or special spaces, these garlands make every little corner even more cosy and full of personality.

options.letras.name.t: How many letters in the name

gpsr.warnings.0.t: Always hang out of reach of the baby — above or outside the cot, never inside it: the string could entangle. Check occasionally that it remains securely fastened.
